{{Quote|It was on Dantooine that I would encounter Falon Grey, one of the last of the Jedi, and learn the true identity of my genetic father. I would also be reunited with X1, this time on opposite sides of the battle lines.|[[X2]]|<ref name="ES">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref>}}
The '''Battle of Dantooine''' occurred during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]] when an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] strike force attempted to find and kill [[Falon Grey]], who was hiding on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[X1]] spearheaded the assault, but [[X2]] joined the rebels inside, taking a different path from his brother.

==History==
The [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] sent [[X1]], [[X2]], and other [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] to root out and destroy a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that the local villagers had been harboring onplanet. While en route to Dantooine, X2 decided that siding with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was wrong, and opposed the Empire, as well as his [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] brother, X1.

X2 then arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], defected, and helped the villagers repel the brutal Imperial invasion. During the battle, he encountered the Jedi [[Falon Grey]], a veteran of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Grey was revealed to be his and X1's genetic father.
[[File:Falon_GreyX2.jpg|thumb|left|210px|X2 meets Falon Grey.]]

With the initial Imperial invasion in full swing, [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were sent to villages known to harbor Rebel activists, and assaulted the locales using [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RTs]].

X2 managed to halt the charge by using [[Mine/Legends|mines]] to cut off a reinforcement point at a landing pad, but this action did not forestall the expedition for long. Imperial [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT]] gunships were en route, with reinforcements for the Empire in transit. It fell to X2 to man the [[Unidentified Dantooine village|village's]] [[Anti-aircraft cannon/Legends|AA gun]] and shoot down the marauding transports.

Towards the end of the battle, Grey, X2 and a group of Dantooinian rebels escaped through the [[Jedi Enclave]] on the planet, planning to make use of a primitive hangar to escape. When the hangar door was finally opened with help from X2, several Imperial LAATs carrying X1 and a group of clone soldiers appeared to block off their escape. They mercilessly opened fire, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the rebels and wounding X2.

Grey incapacitated the clones, as X1 engaged him with a [[Force pike/Legends|force pike]]. Grey defeated him, surrendered the force pike to X1 and yielded his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] as a gesture of reconciliation. X1 disabled Falon Grey with the force pike, and dispatched him with a blaster shot. X1 and the other soldiers left, leaving the unconscious X2 for dead.

Grey healed X2 before finally dying.

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Invasion of Dantooine was created for the [[2009]] video game [[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]], and is a playable level in all versions of the game. The mission serves to establish backstory for X1 and X2, and how they came to oppose each other.
